IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the short notice for the post of CRP SPL XV 16th Specialist Officer SO. This recruitment has been issued for 745 posts. The online application process for IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Recruitment 2026 has started on 01 July 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 21 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 July 2026
  • Edit Application Window : : Notify Later
  • Pre Admit Card : August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : August 2026
  • Pre Result : September/ October 2026
  • Mains Admit Card: October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : November 2026
  • Mains Result : November 2026
  • Interview Letter : November 2026
  • Interview Date : November/ December 2026
  • Final Result : January 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Application Correction Charge : Rs. 200/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

IBPS Specialist Officer SO 16th Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 21 July 2026.
